steps.en: The driver's latest mobile number is fetched from the data source
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru driver diambil dari sumber data
steps.why_en: The refresh from the data source is off in all environments, so the saved number is used.
steps.why_id: Pengambilan ulang dari sumber data mati di semua environment, jadi nomor tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: One driver gets one SMS covering their outstanding fines
steps.id: Satu driver dapat satu SMS untuk semua denda outstanding
steps.why_en: Fines with different due dates still produce separate SMSes, and two drivers sharing a phone each get one.
steps.why_id: Denda dengan tanggal jatuh tempo beda tetap jadi SMS terpisah, dan dua driver satu nomor masing-masing dikirimi.

steps.en: Opted-out, passport and no-mobile drivers are not texted
steps.id: Driver opt-out, passport dan tanpa mobile tidak dikirimi SMS

steps.en: The text lists outstanding fines and refers to the 2nd letter
steps.id: Teks menyebut denda outstanding dan merujuk ke surat ke-2
steps.why_en: The message wording is stored in the database and cannot be read from the code.
steps.why_id: Isi pesan disimpan di database dan tidak bisa dibaca dari kode.

steps.en: The SMS goes out to drivers in a batch
steps.id: SMS dikirim ke driver dalam batch
steps.why_en: In the production settings SMS sending and the scheduled job are both off, so nothing is sent.
steps.why_id: Di pengaturan produksi pengiriman SMS dan job terjadwal sama-sama mati, jadi tidak ada yang terkirim.
